title: Hearty Juicy Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Venezuela with these nutty and juicy chicken skewers, perfect for a diabetic-friendly dinner option. The binchotan-charcoal adds a smoky depth to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, using the binchotan-charcoal for a smoky flavor.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as grilled vegetables or quinoa.
Refrigerate any leftovers and consume within a day or two.
